director_review: Conversation panel shows choice numbers ('1. text') for number-key shortcuts; the T17 criterion says 'No numbers appear anywhere in the panel'.
Start screen title shows the pack name ('STAND-IN Pack'); the spec says 'the game's title'.
Default locked line wording 'That is not open to you yet.' (pack can override) - open creative question.
Town look (T15): colours, demeanor posture table, tell lean sizes, Warm overriding authored facing, name tags through buildings.
Screens' look (T19 party, T20 save, T21 start, T22 hand-off amber band): placeholder Equinox styling; theme MutedLabel too faint on dark backdrops.
open_for_later: Export sprint: export presets must exclude godot/tests/*, TestRunner.tscn and godot/devtools/* resources (the csproj removes only C#); add *.json to non-resource filters.
Town tests needed a 5-physics-frame wait before a new town after freeing the previous scene (test-only; watch navigation readiness after Return to Start then New Game in play).
Stand-in pack: Elder 'warm' and 'override' cannot both be taken in one game; 'ask' only on the first visit; 'favor' never seen locked after 'warm'.
Saves: char.IsControl misses bidi/format characters in names (harmless locally).
